title: Scandinavian Child Recalls Cariboo™ Baby Changing Tables Due to Fall Hazard
summary: If the zipper is misaligned, it can come apart and allow the cloth surface to separate, posing a fall hazard to the baby. Units: About 90 Folding Changing Tables and about 40 Bassinet Changers.

title: Black & Decker Recalls Blower/Vacuums for Fire Hazard
summary: A loose connection between the blower/vac and an extension cord can cause overheating, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 272,000.

title: Agio International Recalls Outdoor Gas Fire Pits Due to Fire Hazard
summary: If the regulator hose for the propane cylinder contacts the burner during use, the hose can rupture, presenting a risk of a fire outside of the unit. Units: About 22,000.

title: MTD Snow Throwers Recalled - Plastic Wheel Rims Can Burst and Injure Users
summary: If the snow thrower's tires are over-inflated, the plastic wheel rims can burst, posing a risk of lacerations and fractures. Units: About 130,000.

title: FreeMotion Fitness Inc. Recalls Exercise Machines - Weights Can Unexpectedly Drop, Hit Users
summary: The selector pin for the weight plates can slip out of its slot if the edges of the pin are worn, allowing the weights to drop suddenly. Falling weight plates can hit consumers using the machines. Units: About 5,600.

title: Scubapro® Recalls MK 20 Scuba Regulators for Service
summary: Over-tightening of the Yoke or Din retainer during annual servicing of these regulators could result in a stress crack and failure of the regulator. If this occurs during a dive, air supply could be interrupted, posing a drowning hazard. Units: About 48,500 units.

title: Bicycle Pedals Recalled by Time Sport International Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The pedal's bearing cap can fail causing the pedal to come off the bicycle. This poses a fall hazard for riders. Units: About 18,000.

title: Delta Faucet Co. Recalls Bathtub and Shower Temperature Control Valves Due to Scald Hazard
summary: The device in the valve that limits the amount of hot water that can flow from the shower head or bathtub spout can disengage after being manually set, causing consumers to come in contact with water that is hotter than expected. This poses a risk of scalding injuries. Units: About 105,000.

title: ITT Water Technology Inc. Expands Recall of Faulty Pumps for Fire Suppression Systems
summary: A mechanical part on these pumps was not fully secured, which can lead to the pump failing during use. If pumps sold with fire suppression systems fail, the risk of fire damage increases. The pump itself does not pose a fire hazard. These pumps were previously recalled for the same hazard in August

title: Streetlights Recalled by Beacon Products Due to Injury Hazard to Passersby
summary: The lighting fixtures could fall from their lamp posts due to a problem with the coupling system used to secure them. This poses a risk of injury for persons beneath the lighting fixtures. Units: About 1,500.

title: Wal-Mart Recalls Home Trends Footstools for Collapse Hazard
summary: Due to improper construction, the stool can break and collapse, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 165,000.

title: Wal-Mart Recalls Minnie Mouse Cardigan Sets Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: If the cardigan is buttoned, the ribbon woven around the neckline poses a strangulation hazard for children. Units: About 14,000.

title: Halloween Pumpkin Decoration Kits Sold at Target Stores Recalled by Paper Magic Group Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The pumpkin decoration kits contain small parts that pose a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 97,000.

title: Sony Recalls Notebook Computer Batteries Due to Previous Fires
summary: These lithium-ion batteries can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 340,000 batteries (an additional 3,080,000 battery packs were sold worldwide).

title: Dux Interiors Protective Mattress Covers Recalled for Fire Hazard
summary: The terry cloth PMCs, which were made to fit over the Dux top pads, do not meet the federal standard for flammability under the Flammable Fabrics Act. They pose a risk of burn injury to consumers if exposed to smoldering or burning cigarettes. Units: About 37,000.

title: Kawasaki Motors Corp., USA Recalls ATV for Loss of Steering Control Hazard
summary: The nuts securing the tie-rod ends to the steering shaft may not have been tightened sufficiently during assembly. If the nuts loosen during operation, the operator could lose steering control, posing a risk of crashing. Units: 291.

title: Baby Cookie Monster Toys Sold with DVD at Wal-Mart Recalled for Choking Hazard
summary: The small felt fabric cookie attached to the plush toy's hand can be removed easily and ingested by young children, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 31,000.

title: Petzl America Recalls Climbing Equipment Due to Fall Hazard
summary: These carabiners have a green button that acts as a safety mechanism to prevent unlocking. The recalled carabiners can unlock unexpectedly without pressing the green button, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 8,000.

title: Decathlon USA Announces Recall of Quechua Tents and Canopies Due to Flammability Hazard
summary: The tents may fail to meet the industry's flame resistant standard, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 22,000.

title: Light & Motion Recalls Bicycle Light Batteries for Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The battery can overheat, posing a fire or burn hazard to users. Units: About 1,700.

title: Starbucks Announces Recall of 8-Cup Coffee Brewers Due to Possible Fire Hazard
summary: The coffee brewer has defective electrical wiring that can result in overheating, smoking, burning and melting, posing a possible fire hazard. Units: About 73,000.

title: Cobb America Inc. Warns Charcoal Grill Purchasers of CO Hazard
summary: Like all charcoal grills, this grill emits carbon monoxide gas, which can kill within minutes when used indoors. The Web sites, recipe book, and visuals in a promotional video create the impression that the Cobb Cooker can be used indoors. The recipe book says that it can be used on your dining room

title: Family Dollar Recalls "Creepy Cape" Costumes Due to Flammability Hazard
summary: These vinyl capes fail to meet the standard for the flammability of vinyl plastic film, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 120,000.

title: Weil-McLain Recalls Ultra Series Boilers for Carbon Monoxide Hazard
summary: These boilers were manufactured for use with natural gas, but could have a blue tag incorrectly indicating to installers that they are intended for use with LP (propane) gas.
